10001.name: Count Dooku
10001.text: Power Action - Play a Blue card from your hand (paying its cost). Then force an opponent to discard a card from their hand.

10002.name: Count Dooku's Lightsaber
10002.text: After you play this upgrade, if it is on a Sith, you may deal 1 damage to a character that has no shields, or, if it is on Count Dooku, you may force an opponent to discard a card from their hand.

10003.name: Sniper Team
10003.text: Power Action - Discard a card from your hand to turn this die to the side that has a value 1 higher than the value showing on this die.

10004.name: Astrogation
10004.text: After you play an upgrade, you may exhaust this plot and spot a Blue character to discard the top card of a deck.

10005.name: Knighthood
10005.text: Blue character only. Attached character gains Jedi. After you play this upgrade, you may give a character 1 shield.

10006.name: Fenn Rau
10006.text: Power Action - Play a Red card from your hand (paying its cost). Then deal 1 indirect damage ([indirect]) to an opponent.

10007.name: Test of Character
10007.text: Choose 2 dice that share a subtype (yours and/or opponents'). Then turn one of those dice to any side and reroll the other die.

10008.name: Grand Design
10008.text: After you play a support, you may exhaust this plot and spot a Red character to draw a card.

10009.name: Outer Rim Outlaw
10009.text: Power Action - Play a Yellow card from your hand (paying its cost). Then reroll an opponent's die or reroll up to 3 of your dice.

10010.name: Shadowed
10010.text: After attached character uses its action (including power action), you may deal 1 indirect damage ([indirect]) to its controller.

10011.name: Perilous Escapade
10011.text: After you play a downgrade, you may exhaust this plot and spot a Yellow character to deal 1 indirect damage ([indirect]) to an opponent.

10013.name: Clawdite Shapeshifter
10013.text: After you activate this character, you may choose a character subtype. Until the end of this round, this character gains the chosen subtype.

10014.name: Chance Encounter
10014.text: Choose and do one: • Spot a leader to turn a die to any side. • Spot a scoundrel to reroll up to 3 dice. • Spot a trooper to remove a die showing a value of 1 or less.

10015.name: Flank
10015.text:
Play only if you have more ready characters than an opponent.
Remove one of that opponent's dice.

10016.name: Allies of Necessity
10016.text:
Include only if 2 or more characters on your team share a color.
After setup, discard a card from your hand and lose 2 resources.

10017.name: LR-57 Combat Droid
10017.text:
After you play this support, place 1 resource on it.
[special] - Place 1 resource on this support. Then deal damage to a character equal to the number of resources on this support.

10018.name: Electro Sword
10018.text:
Redeploy.
Damage dealt by this die is unblockable.

10019.name: Chalmun's Cantina
10019.text: Power Action - Reroll a character die (yours or an opponent's). Then you may reroll another die that shares a subtype with that die.

10020.name: Wheeta Palace
10020.text: Claim - Place 1 resource on this battlefield. Power Action - Place 1 resource on this battlefield or take all resources from it.

11001.name: Dark Mystic
11001.text: [special] - Play a Blue upgrade from your hand or discard pile (paying its cost). Then roll that upgrade's die into your pool.

11002.name: Kylo Ren
11002.text: Power Action - Move 1 shield from this character to another character. Then, if you moved that shield to a hero, deal 1 damage to a character. [special] - Deal 2 damage to a character. If any of this damage is blocked, reroll this die instead of removing it.

11003.name: Maul
11003.text: Power Action - Reroll one of this character's character or upgrade dice. You may discard a card from your hand to reroll that die again. If that die is showing melee damage ([melee]), you may remove it to deal damage equal to its value to 2 characters.

11004.name: Nightsister Zombie
11004.text: Indirect damage ([indirect]) dealt to you must be assigned to this character last. After you activate this character, you may spot another witch to deal 1 damage to a character that has a curse on them.

11005.name: Old Daka
11005.text: After this character is defeated, set each Nightsister Zombie you control aside. Power Action - Spend 1 resource to add a set-aside Nightsister Zombie ([SoH]4) to your team exhausted, or 2 Nightsister Zombies exhausted instead if this character is elite.

11006.name: Chancellor's Edict
11006.text:
After this downgrade is played, remove all shields from attached character.
After attached character is defeated, you may give a character 2 shields.

11007.name: Hex
11007.text: Action - Exhaust this downgrade to remove one of attached character's character die showing a blank ([blank]).

11008.name: Possessed
11008.text: Discard this downgrade from play if you do not control a witch. Action - Exhaust this downgrade to resolve one of attached character's character dice as if it were in your pool.

11009.name: Uncontrollable Rage
11009.text: Action - Exhaust this downgrade to deal 1 damage to attached character, or 2 damage instead if you spot a witch. Use this action only if attached character is ready and it is not the first turn of the round.

11010.name: Act of Betrayal
11010.text: Remove an upgrade die. Then deal damage equal to the value showing on that die to a character.

11011.name: Dark Magick
11011.text: Choose a character and reroll any number of its character dice. Deal 1 damage to that character if it has a curse on it.

11012.name: Sinister Ruse
11012.text: Reveal a random card in an opponent's hand and deal indirect damage ([indirect]) to them equal to the cost of the revealed card.

11013.name: Tantrum
11013.text: Discard an equipment or a weapon upgrade you control to remove a die.

11014.name: Weave the Ichor
11014.text: Spot up to 3 witch characters to heal that much damage from a character.

11015.name: Order 66
11015.text: Each of your opponents' characters gains Jedi. Before you draw your starting hand, shuffle up to 4 set-aside copies of Execute Order 66 ([SoH]27) into your deck.

11016.name: Scimitar
11016.text: Before the effects of an opponent's event resolve, you may return this support from play to its owner's hand. Then gain 1 resource, or 2 resources instead if you spot Maul.

11017.name: Ancient Magicks
11017.text: Blue character only. [special] - Deal 1 indirect damage ([indirect]) to an opponent. You may ready a curse.

11018.name: Recovered Sith Lightsaber
11018.text: After you play this upgrade, you may remove 1 shield from a character, or 2 shields from a character instead if this upgrade is on a Sith.

11019.name: Talisman of Resurrection
11019.text: Witch character only. [special] - Gain 2 resources. Then you may spend resources equal to the point value of a defeated character to return it to play under you control.

11020.name: Conan Motti
11020.text: After you resolve this die showing a discard ([discard]), you may discard a card from your hand to remove a die.

11021.name: Gideon Hask
11021.text: Power Action - If you control the battlefield, roll a trooper die on a card you control into your pool.

11022.name: Mudtrooper
11022.text: After you activate this character or a leader, you may reroll one of your dice showing a blank ([blank]).

11023.name: Thrawn
11023.text: After you activate this character, you may look at the top 4 cards of a deck. Power Action - Reveal the top 4 cards of an opponent's deck. You may play an event revealed this way and spot that opponent's cards as if they were yours.

11024.name: Priority Target
11024.text: After attached character is defeated, you may take control of the battlefield and use its claim ability or power action, even if it was used this round.

11025.name: Counterintelligence
11025.text: Spot a leader to look at an opponent's hand and place an event from it on top of their deck.

11026.name: Crushing Advantage
11026.text: If you have more character dice in your pool than an opponent has in their pool, remove one of that opponent's character dice. Repeat this for support dice and upgrade dice.

11027.name: Execute Order 66
11027.text: Remove all Jedi dice. For each die removed, deal 1 damage to its matching character.

11028.name: Rally the Troops
11028.text: Choose a character subtype. Then either reroll any number of dice that have that subtype or resolve 2 of your dice that have that subtype.

11029.name: To Victory
11029.text: Gain resources equal to the number of defeated characters an opponent has.

11030.name: Warning Siren
11030.text: Remove a die showing the same value as one of your dice.

11031.name: Cultural Records
11031.text:
After a player plays a copy of a card set aside by this support, you may gain 1 resource or remove a die.
[special] - Look at an opponent's hand and set a card from it aside. Gain 1 action.

11032.name: Hostile Territory
11032.text: After the upkeep phase begins, deal 2  indirect damage ([indirect]) to each player that does not control the battlefield.

11033.name: Separatist Embargo
11033.text:
After you play this support, name a card.
Copies of the named card cannot be played.

11034.name: Superlaser Siege Cannon
11034.text: Before you resolve this die, you may remove all resources from this support to increase its value by that amount. Power Action - Place 1 resource on this support. Spend up to 4 resources to place those resources on this support.

11035.name: Crimson Star
11035.text: Play only if an opponent has one or more defeated characters. Action - Exhaust this upgrade to resolve one of attached character's character dice, increasing its value by 1.

11036.name: Mastermind
11036.text: [special] - Name a card. Then reveal an opponent's hand and set each copy of the named card from it aside.

11037.name: TL-50 Heavy Repeater
11037.text: Power Action - If this upgrade is on a trooper, turn this die to any side. [special] - Deal 1 indirect damage ([indirect]) to an opponent. Reroll this die instead of removing it.

11038.name: 4-LOM
11038.text: After a bounty you control is discarded from play, you may add it to your hand.

11039.name: IG-88
11039.text: Power Action - Resolve one of your bounty hunter dice showing ranged or melee damage against any number of characters that have a bounty on them.

11040.name: Jango Fett
11040.text: Each equipment on this character does not count toward its upgrade limit. After you play an equipment on this character for the first time each round, you may gain 1 resource.

11041.name: Zuckuss
11041.text: [special] - Gain 1 resource or trigger the "After attached character is defeated" ability on a bounty you control and discard it.

11042.name: Armed To The Teeth
11042.text: Discard any number of upgrades on one of your Yellow characters. Then deal damage to a character equal to the number of upgrades you just discarded.

11043.name: Desperate Measures
11043.text: Spot a Yellow character to discard a support from play. Then deal indirect damage ([indirect]) to yourself equal to the cost of that support.

11044.name: Misinformation
11044.text: Choose up to 2 cards in an opponent's discard pile and place them on top of their deck in any order.

11045.name: Tireless Pursuit
11045.text: Ambush. Move up to 2 damage from an opponent's character to a character that has a bounty on it.

11046.name: Bounty Hunters' Guild
11046.text: Each of your opponents' characters has +1 downgrade limit. After you play a bounty, you may activate one of your bounty hunters.

11047.name: IG-2000
11047.text: This support gains bounty hunter while you control a bounty hunter. Decrease the cost on this die by 1 while you control IG-88.

11048.name: Impound
11048.text: Before an opponent's equipment or weapon upgrade would be discarded from play, you may instead discard this support from play to take control of that upgrade and move it to one of your bounty hunter characters.

11049.name: Mist Hunter
11049.text: After you activate a bounty hunter you may activate this support. Then you may spot 4-LOM to reroll this die. You may spot Zuckuss to resolve this die.

11050.name: Predatory Banker
11050.text: Action - Exhaust this support to take 1 resource from an opponent that has 3 or more resources. Use this ability only if you do not control the battlefield.

11052.name: Armor Plating
11052.text: Before attached character takes damage, you may discard this upgrade to block 2 damage.

11053.name: Gauntlet Rockets
11053.text: Bounty hunter only. Action - Choose a character. Turn this die to a side showing a value equal to or less than the number of bounties on that character.

11054.name: Pulse Cannon
11054.text: Power Action - Resolve this die. Then roll this die into your pool and resolve it, if able. Then roll this die into your pool again and resolve it, if able.

11055.name: Acceptable Losses
11055.text: Defeat up to 3 of your characters to gain that many resources.

11056.name: R2-D2
11056.text: You cannot play Blue abilities on this character. After you activate this character, you may turn one of your dice to its first side (the topmost box of its dice reference), or to any side instead if you spot C-3PO.

11057.name: Rey
11057.text: Power Action - Reroll a character die or turn a villain character die to a side showing a value of 0. [special] - Give 2 shields to a character. Then, if that character has 3 or more shields, reroll this die instead of removing it.

11058.name: Yoda
11058.text: This character has +3 shield limit. The character's shields can be used to block damage dealt to apprentice characters.

11059.name: Youngling
11059.text: Include only if you have a Jedi on your team. Power Action - Play a Blue upgrade from your hand onto this character, decreasing its cost by 1.

11060.name: Refusal
11060.text:
Damage symbols ([ranged], [melee], or [indirect]) on attached character's character dice are resource symbols ([resource]) instead.
After attached character is dealt damage, discard this downgrade.

11061.name: Destiny Fulfilled
11061.text: Defeat one of your characters to give 3 shields to your characters, distributed as you wish.

11062.name: Exchange Of Information
11062.text: Reveal your hand and gain 1 resource. Each opponent may reveal their hand and gain 1 resource.

11063.name: Heroic Stand
11063.text:
Play only if you control exactly one character and an opponent has 3 or more dice showing damage ([ranged], [melee], or [indirect]).
Ready a character.

11064.name: Humble Service
11064.text: Choose up to 4 of your dice and turn each of them to sides showing a different value than each other.

11065.name: Jedi Mind Trick
11065.text: Spot a Jedi to choose a dice pool. An opponent splits the dice in that pool into 2 groups of any size. Either remove all dice in a group, or turn any number of dice in a group to sides of your choice.

11066.name: Moving Rocks
11066.text: Spot an apprentice or a Jedi to move any number of shields to any number of characters.

11067.name: Yoda's Protection
11067.text: Give each of your Blue characters 1 shield.

11068.name: Caretaker Village
11068.text: After an opponent's effect removes one of your apprentice or Jedi dice, you may exhaust this support to roll that die into your pool.

11069.name: Professor Huyang
11069.text: After you play a Blue upgrade on an apprentice, you may activate this support. Then, if that upgrade is a weapon, you may roll its die into your pool.

11070.name: Qui-Gon Jinn's Spirit
11070.text:
Discard this support from play if you control Qui-Gon Jinn.
[special] - Shuffle this support into its owner's deck to give a character 1 shield. Then remove any number of shields from your characters to deal that much damage to a character.

11071.name: Three Lessons
11071.text: This support enters play with 3 resources on it. Action - Exhaust this support, remove a resource from it, and spot a Jedi to turn an apprentice die to any side.

11072.name: Jedi Lightsaber
11072.text: After you play this upgrade, you may give attached character 1 shield, or 2 shields instead if this upgrade is on a Jedi.

11073.name: Sacred Jedi Texts
11073.text: After you resolve this die, you may move this upgrade to one of your apprentice or Jedi characters. [special] - Draw a card.

11074.name: Yoda's Lightsaber
11074.text:
After you play this upgrade on Yoda, you may give him 1 shield.
[special] - Deal 1 unblockable damage to a character, or 2 unblockable damage instead if you remove 1 shield from attached character.

11075.name: Amilyn Holdo
11075.text: After this character is defeated, you may ready a vehicle. [special] - Gain 1 resource or play a vehicle from your hand, decreasing its cost by 2.

11076.name: Bail Organa
11076.text: Decrease the cost of the first title you play each round by 1. [special] - Choose a subtype. Reroll any number of dice with that subtype. You may turn one of those dice to any side.

11077.name: C-3PO
11077.text: After you activate this character, you may resolve one of your dice, increasing its value by 1 if you spend 1 resource or spot R2-D2.

11078.name: Hoth Trooper
11078.text: After you activate this character, you may deal 1 damage to a ready character.

11079.name: Droids' Day Out
11079.text: Activate any number of your droids. Then, if you just activated 3 or more droids, draw a card.

11080.name: Happy Beeps
11080.text: Turn one of your non-droid character dice to any side. Then you may turn one of your droid dice to a side showing the same symbol and value as that character die.

11081.name: Lightspeed Assault
11081.text: Defeat one of your leader characters and discard a vehicle you control. Then discard an opponent's vehicle from play and deal indirect damage ([indirect]) to them equal to the discarded vehicles' combined cost.

11082.name: Our Situation is Desperate
11082.text: Spot any number of characters that have 3 or less remaining health to remove that many dice.

11083.name: Rebel Assault
11083.text:
Play only if you have one or more dice showing ranged damage ([ranged]).
Remove an opponent's die not showing damage ([ranged], [melee], or [indirect]).

11084.name: Spark of Hope
11084.text:
Decrease the cost of this event by 1 for each defeated character you have.
Reroll any number of your dice. Then resolve any number of your dice.

11085.name: Take Control
11085.text: Play a vehicle in an opponent's discard pile for free. After the upkeep phase begins, discard that vehicle from play.

11086.name: B-Wing
11086.text: After the action phase begins, you may activate this support.

11087.name: Firm Resolve
11087.text: After one of your characters is defeated or a vehicle you control is discarded, you may place 1 resource on this support. Action - Remove 1 resource from this support to turn a die to any side.

11088.name: GH-7 Droid
11088.text: [special] - Heal 1 damage from a character and discard a downgrade on it.

11089.name: Resistance Trench Fighters
11089.text: Action - Remove this die to remove a die showing an equal value.

11090.name: EL-16 Heavy Field Blaster
11090.text: Before you resolve this die, you may increase its value by 1 if it modifies a trooper die.

11091.name: Salvaged Arm
11091.text: Modify droid character or support. Before you resolve one of attached droid's character, support, or upgrade dice, you may exhaust this upgrade to increase its value by 1.

11092.name: Tico Pendant
11092.text: Action - Exhaust this upgrade to move 1 damage from another character to attached character, or up to 2 damage instead if the other character has a copy of this upgrade on it.

11093.name: Chief Chirpa
11093.text: After setup, add a set-aside Ewok Warrior ([SoH]95) to your team. [special] - Deal 2 indirect damage ([indirect]) to an opponent, or 3 indirect damage instead if you spot 4 Ewoks.

11094.name: Chopper
11094.text: Power Action - Play a mod from your hand or discard pile onto this character, decreasing its cost by 1.

11095.name: Ewok Warrior
11095.text: Include only if you have a unique Ewok on your team. After you activate this character, you may deal 1 indirect damage ([indirect]) to an opponent.

11096.name: Han Solo
11096.text: Power Action - Turn one of your scoundrel dice showing a resource ([resource]) to any side. If it is a Wookiee die, you may resolve it for free.

11097.name: Wicket
11097.text: After you activate this character, you may play a trap from your hand or discard pile.

11098.name: Ensnare
11098.text: After attached character is activated, you may discard this downgrade to deal damage to it equal to the number of its character and upgrade dice showing damage ([ranged], [melee], or [indirect]).

11099.name: Net Trap
11099.text: After attached character is activated, you may discard this downgrade to remove one of its character or upgrade dice showing damage ([ranged], [melee], or [indirect]).

11100.name: Rolling Logs
11100.text: After attached character is activated, you may discard this downgrade to reroll any number of its character and upgrade dice.

11101.name: Ewok Ambush
11101.text: Ambush. Activate one of your non-elite characters or up to 3 of your Ewok characters.

11102.name: Glider Attack
11102.text: Exhaust one of your Ewok characters to deal 3 indirect damage ([indirect]) to an opponent. That opponent may spend up to 3 resources to block that much damage.

11103.name: Jump To Lightspeed
11103.text: Spot a vehicle support to end the action phase. Set this event aside.

11104.name: Reassemble
11104.text: Play a droid support from your discard pile. Then play up to 3 upgrades that have Modify droid from your discard pile onto that droid support, decreasing each of their costs by 1.

11105.name: Chief Chirpa's Hut
11105.text: [special] - Add a set-aside Ewok Warrior ([SoH]95) to your team. Discard this support from play unless you spend 3 resources.

11106.name: Mr. Bones
11106.text: After you resolve this die showing melee damage ([melee]), if one or more characters were just defeated, you may ready this support.

11107.name: Ewok Bow
11107.text: While this upgrade is on an Ewok, it gains Redeploy.

11108.name: Han Solo's Blaster
11108.text:
Ambush.
After you play this upgrade, you may force an opponent to remove one of their dice showing damage. Then, if this upgrade is on Han Solo, you may activate him.

11109.name: Han Solo's Dice
11109.text: After one of attached character's character dice rolls a blank ([blank]), you may exhaust this upgrade to reroll it. Then, if this upgrade is on Han Solo, you may ready this upgrade.

11110.name: Support of the Tribe
11110.text: Spot a number of characters that share a subtype to heal that much damage from a character.

11111.name: Fateful Companions
11111.text: After you activate a character, you may exhaust this plot and either spot R2-D2 and C-3PO or spend 1 resource to trigger that character's "After you activate this character" ability one additional time.

11112.name: Alter Fate
11112.text: Remove all of an opponent's dice showing damage ([ranged], [melee], or [indirect]).

11113.name: Clever Distraction
11113.text: Spot a Blue character to choose one: â€¢ Turn one of your dice to any side. â€¢ Discard the top 2 cards of a deck. â€¢ Remove a trooper die.

11114.name: Dark Reflections
11114.text: Turn a die to a side showing a value of 1 or more. Then turn up to 2 other dice to sides showing the same symbol and value as that die.

11115.name: Decisive Blow
11115.text: Resolve one of your dice showing melee damage ([melee]) against a character. Then remove all of that character's character and upgrade dice.

11116.name: Draw Closer
11116.text: Resolve one of your character or upgrade dice showing melee damage ([melee]) without removing it from your pool, increasing its value by 2 if that character has an upgrade titled Niman Mastery on it.

11117.name: Polarity
11117.text:
Ambush.
Spot a hero character to give a character 1 shield. Spot a villain character to deal 1 damage to a character.

11118.name: Pushing Slash
11118.text: Activate one of your Blue characters. Then you may resolve one of that character's character or upgrade dice. If that character has a card titled Niman Mastery on it, you may turn a die to any side.

11119.name: Temporary Truce
11119.text: You can only include Kylo Ren and Rey on your team (you can include villain and hero cards in your deck). You cannot include Gray cards in your deck.

11120.name: Force Connection
11120.text: Action - Exhaust this support and spot 2 Blue characters to turn one of their character dice to a side showing the same symbol as one of the other character's character dice.

11121.name: Mysteries of the Force
11121.text: Action - Discard this support from play and remove 5 of your dice showing one of each of the symbols: melee damage ([melee]), shield ([shield]), resource ([resource]), special ([special]), and blank ([blank]). Then play up to 3 upgrades from your hand and/or discard pile for free.

11122.name: Niman Mastery
11122.text: Blue character only. Limit 1 form per character. After you play this upgrade, turn a character or upgrade die to any side. [special] - Turn a character and upgrade die to the sides of your choice.

11123.name: Niman Training
11123.text:
Blue character only.
[special] - Turn an upgrade die to any side. You may discard this upgrade to play a card titled Niman Mastery from your hand or discard pile on attached character for free.

11124.name: Untamed Power
11124.text: Apprentice character only. [special] - If this upgrade is on a hero, give a character 1 shield and remove a die showing damage. If it is on a villain, deal 1 damage to a character and remove a die not showing damage.

11125.name: Chain Lightning
11125.text: Deal 1 damage to a character. Then you may spend 1 resource to deal 2 damage to another character that shares a subtype with that character.

11126.name: Focused Fire
11126.text: Resolve up to 2 of your dice showing ranged damage ([ranged]) against the same character, increasing each of their values by 1.

11127.name: Hull Breach
11127.text: Remove one of your dice showing damage ([ranged], [melee], or [indirect]) to either discard a support from play that costs equal to or less than the value showing on the removed die, or deal that much indirect damage ([indirect]) to an opponent.

11128.name: Off The Sensors
11128.text: Spot a Red character to choose one: â€¢ Resolve one of your dice, increasing its value by 1. â€¢ Activate 2 of your characters or supports. â€¢ Remove a scoundrel die.

11129.name: Seizing Territory
11129.text: Ambush. Spot a trooper to take control of the battlefield.

11130.name: Shields Are Down
11130.text: Choose a character that has no shields and remove one of its character dice.

11131.name: Shortcut
11131.text: Spot a vehicle to switch the battlefield with a set-aside battlefield.

11132.name: You Are In Command Now
11132.text: Ambush. Play a title from your hand or discard pile, decreasing its cost by 1 and ignoring its play restrictions.

11133.name: Aftermath
11133.text: After a character is defeated, you may exhaust this support to gain 1 resource.

11134.name: AT-RT
11134.text: The modifier sides of this die can be resolved with one of your trooper dice showing any symbol.

11135.name: Coruscant Police
11135.text: After you play this support, you may remove a scoundrel die.

11136.name: Admiral
11136.text: Leader character only. After you play this upgrade, you may spend 2 resources to ready a character or vehicle. [special] - Exhaust this upgrade to ready a character or vehicle.

11137.name: Communication Module
11137.text: Modify droid character or support. After you activate attached droid, if it is a character, you may turn a support die to any side. If it is a support, you may turn a character die to any side.

11138.name: Dead Or Alive
11138.text: Play only if you spot a bounty hunter. After attached character is activated, you may gain 1 resource. After attached character is defeated, you may gain 1 resource.

11139.name: Bad Credit
11139.text: Remove all of an opponent's dice showing a resource ([resource]).

11140.name: Disassemble
11140.text: Discard a diceless support, upgrade, or downgrade from play.

11141.name: Encircle
11141.text: Spot 3 exhausted characters to remove all character dice.

11142.name: I Performed Violence
11142.text: Ambush. Resolve one of your character or droid dice showing melee damage ([melee]) as unblockable, increasing its value by 1, or by 2 instead if it is a Mr. Bones die.

11143.name: Kinship
11143.text: Spot 3 characters that share a subtype to gain 1 resource, or 2 resources instead if you spot 6 characters that share a subtype.

11144.name: Outpace
11144.text: Spot a Yellow character to choose one: â€¢ Reroll up to 3 dice. â€¢ Force an opponent to lose 1 resource. â€¢ Remove a leader die.

11145.name: Practice Makes Perfect
11145.text: Choose a die and reroll it up to 5 times.

11146.name: Reversal
11146.text: Spot a Yellow character to remove a die showing damage ([ranged], [melee], or [indirect]). Then deal damage to a character equal to the value showing on that die.

11147.name: Simple Mistake
11147.text: The player who controls the battlefield chooses a die in their pool. Then remove that die or resolve it as if it were in your pool.

11148.name: Unify
11148.text: Choose a character subtype on one of your characters. Until the end of the round, your other characters gain the chosen subtype.

11149.name: Any Means Necessary
11149.text: Action - Exhaust this plot and remove one of your bounty hunter dice to deal 1 unblockable damage to a character, or 2 unblockable damage instead if that character has 3 or more bounties on it.

11150.name: Canto Bight Security
11150.text: After this support is discarded from your hand by an opponent's effect, you may play it for free.

11151.name: Mining Guild TIE Fighter
11151.text: After an opponent's effect causes you to lose 1 or more resources, you may activate this support to deal 1 indirect damage ([indirect]) to them.

11152.name: Bounty Hunter Mask
11152.text: Attached character has +1 health and gains bounty hunter.

11153.name: DX-2 Disruptor Blaster Pistol
11153.text: Damage dealt by this die or by a die that it modifies is unblockable.

11154.name: Inflict Pain
11154.text:
Deal 2 damage to one of your characters to deal 2 indirect damage ([indirect]) to an opponent.
After this event is discarded from your deck, you may add it to your hand.

11155.name: Grappling Arm
11155.text: Modify droid character or support. Action - Remove this die to discard a trap from play.

11156.name: Rocket Booster
11156.text: Modify droid character or support. Action - Activate attached droid. Then resolve any number of its character, support, and upgrade dice. Discard this upgrade.

11157.name: Canto Casino
11157.text: Power Action - Spend 1 resource to reroll 2 dice. Then, if those dice are showing the same value, gain 2 resources, or 3 resources instead if they are also showing the same symbol.

11158.name: Jabba's Palace
11158.text: Claim - Gain 1 resource. You may spot a bounty hunter to force an opponent to lose 1 resource.

11159.name: Nightsister Lair
11159.text: After you play a downgrade for the first time each round, you may gain 1 resource.

11160.name: Snoke's Throne Room
11160.text: Claim - Spot a hero character to give a character 1 shield. Spot a villain character to remove 1 shield from an opponent's character.

12001.name: Darth Bane
12001.text: Decrease the cost of the first ability you play on this character each game by 2. [special] - Choose an upgrade on this character and deal indirect damage to an opponent equal to that upgrade's cost.

12002.name: Darth Vader
12002.text: Piloting. [special] - Deal 2 damage to a character. Then, if that character was just defeated, discard the vehicle it was piloting.

12003.name: Pong Krell
12003.text:
You can include up to 4 different Blue hero cards in your deck.
After you activate this character, you may place a hero card in any player's discard pile on the bottom of their deck. Then deal 1 damage to a character.

12004.name: Snoke's Praetorian Guard
12004.text: After you activate this character, you may remove one of its character dice showing damage to remove a die showing damage with a value of 2 or less.

12005.name: Recurring Nightmare
12005.text: This die can only be resolved against attached character.

12006.name: Entropic Blast
12006.text: Deal 2 damage to each character that has one or more of its character dice in a pool.

12007.name: Legacy of the Sith
12007.text: Play a Blue upgrade from your discard pile, or play it for free instead if you have a defeated character that is 20 or more points.

12008.name: Pincer Movement
12008.text: Activate 2 of your Blue characters. Then turn each of a character's character and upgrade dice to sides showing a blank ([blank]).

12009.name: Quad Slam
12009.text: Choose up to 4 characters and remove one character die belonging to each of them.

12010.name: Trap the Blade
12010.text: Remove a die showing melee damage ([melee]). If it is an upgrade die, you may spot a Blue character and spend 1 resource to discard its matching card from play.

12011.name: Treason
12011.text: Spot a Blue character to remove an opponent's character die showing damage ([ranged], [melee], or [indirect]). Then that opponent deals damage to one of their characters equal to the value showing on that die.

12012.name: Rule of Two
12012.text: If you do not control exactly 2 characters, one that is a Sith and the other an apprentice, set this plot aside an deal 1 indirect damage to yourself. Action - If you have exactly one character die in your pool, exhaust this plot to resolve it, increasing its value by 1.

12013.name: Bloodletting
12013.text: Action - Exhaust this support and deal 1 damage to a character you control to turn one of its character or upgrade dice to any side.

12014.name: Darth Vader's Tie Advanced
12014.text: [special] - Deal 2 damage to a character. You may place 1 damage on a vehicle. Then, if Darth Vader is piloting this support, you may discard a vehicle that has 2 or more damage.

12015.name: Ancient Sith Armor
12015.text: Redeploy. Before attached character takes damage, you may exhaust this upgrade to block 1 damage. After you play an ability on attached character, you may ready this upgrade.

12016.name: Death Field
12016.text: Blue character only. Action - Exhaust this upgrade to roll this die into your pool. [special] - Deal 2 damage to each of an opponent's characters.

12017.name: Pong Krell's Lightsaber
12017.text: Power Action - Spot Pong Krell or spend 1 resource to roll a set-aside copy of this die ([CM]17) into your pool. Set that die aside after it is resolved or removed. [special] - Deal 2 damage to up to 2 characters.

12018.name: Sith Lord
12018.text: Sith character only. [special] - Reroll this die instead of removing it. You may exhaust this upgrade to use a special ability ([special]) on attached character or on a blue ability on attached character.

12019.name: Vibro-Arbir Blades
12019.text: Elite character only. After you play this card from your hand, you may play a set-aside copy of it ([CM]19) (paying its cost.).

12020.name: Commander Pyre
12020.text: After you claim or take control of the battlefield, you may deal 1 indirect damage ([indirect]) to an opponent.

12021.name: Director Krennic
12021.text: The point value of your Death Star plot is decreased by 1. After you activate this character, you may turn one of your dice to a side showing a value of 1.

12022.name: Elrik Vonreg
12022.text: Piloting. While one or more of this character's character dice are in your pool, its piloted vehicle's support and upgrade dice cannot be removed by opponent's effects.

12023.name: Imperial Death Trooper
12023.text: While you control Director Krennic, this character has Guardian. Power Action - Turn this die to a side showing the same symbol and value as another one of your dice.

12024.name: Imperial Pilot
12024.text: Piloting. Power Action - If this character is piloting a Red vehicle, turn its support die to any side.

12025.name: Cruel Methods
12025.text: After you claim or take control of the battlefield, you may deal 1 damage to attached character.

12026.name: Call to Action
12026.text: Spot a character that is 15 or fewer points to roll all of its character dice into your pool.

12027.name: Face the Enemy
12027.text: Spot an exhausted character to force an opponent to draw 2 cards. Then look at that opponent's hand and place up to 2 cards from it on top of their deck in any order.

12028.name: I'll Handle This Myself
12028.text: Turn one of your character dice to any side. If you control exactly one character, you may resolve that die.

12029.name: Taking Charge
12029.text:
Ambush.
If you control the battlefield, remove a die. If you do not control the battlefield, take control of it and you may reroll a die.

12030.name: Construct the Death Star
12030.text: Action - Remove 2 of your dice each showing a resource ([resource]) to place 2 resources on this plot. Then, if 15 or more resources are on this plot, you win the game.

12031.name: Elrik Vonreg's TIE Interceptor
12031.text: Action - If Elrik Vonreg is piloting this support, remove this die to discard an opponent's vehicle from play that costs equal to or less than the value showing on this die.

12032.name: The "Duchess"
12032.text: [special] - Deal 2 damage to each of your opponents' characters. Then deal 1 additional damage to each of those characters that are a trooper.

12033.name: Tie Bomber
12033.text:
This support enters play with 3 resources on it.
[special] - Remove 1 resource from this support to deal 4 indirect damage ([indirect]) to an opponent. You may return this support to your hand.

12034.name: Viper Probe Droid
12034.text: After a die rolls damage ([ranged], [melee], or [indirect]), you may spot a Red character and spend 1 resource to remove that die. Then discard this support.

12035.name: Commander Pyre's Blaster
12035.text: After you play this upgrade on Commander Pyre, you may take control of the battlefield.

12036.name: Director
12036.text: Leader character only. After you resolve or remove one of your Red dice showing a resource ([resource]), you may exhaust this upgrade to roll that die into your pool.

12037.name: E-11D Blaster Rifle
12037.text:
While this upgrade is on an elite character, it has Redeploy.
After you play this upgrade on a non-unique character, you may gain 1 resource.

12038.name: Boba Fett
12038.text: After an opponent's character is defeated, for each bounty on it, you may roll one of this character's character or upgrade dice into your pool.

12039.name: Kragan Gorr
12039.text: After you activate this character, you may activate one of your pirates. If an opponent has an exhausted character and no dice showing damage, you may take 1 resource from them.

12041.name: Synara San
12041.text: After you activate this character, if an opponent has an exhausted character and no dice showing damage, you may force them to choose and discard a card from their hand.

12042.name: Trandoshan Hunter
12042.text: Power Action - Spot a downgrade to turn one of your bounty hunter dice to a side showing damage.

12043.name: Forced Labor
12043.text: After attached character is defeated, you may roll one of its character dice into its owner's pool. Then either resolve that die for free as if it were in your pool or remove it.

12044.name: Pestering
12044.text: After this die is rerolled, you may reroll one of attached character's character dice.

12045.name: Change of Fortune
12045.text: Choose a symbol. Then reroll any number of an opponent's dice. Remove each of those dice that just rolled the chosen symbol.

12046.name: Opportune Strike
12046.text: If each of your opponents has an exhausted character and no dice showing damage ([ranged], [melee], [indirect]), deal 2 indirect damage ([indirect]) to each of them.

12047.name: Plunder
12047.text: Play only if you do not control the battlefield. Spot any number of pirates to take that many resources from an opponent.

12048.name: Warning Shot
12048.text: Choose an opponent's die and remove it unless they give you one resource.

12049.name: Pirate Ship
12049.text: After you activate this support, you may remove a die showing damage. You may activate one of your pirates.

12050.name: Slave I
12050.text: Your Boba Fett and Jango Fett each have Piloting. After this support becomes piloted by a bounty-hunter, you may deal 1 damage to a character.

12051.name: Boba Fett's Wrist Laser
12051.text:
After you play this upgrade on Boba Fett, you may gain 1 action.
After you resolve this die, discard this upgrade from play unless you discard a card from your hand.

12052.name: Pyke Blaster
12052.text: While this upgrade is on a character that has Guardian, it has Redeploy.

12053.name: Anakin Skywalker
12053.text: After you activate this character, you may discard a card from your hand to move 1 shield from a character to another character. Then draw a card if you moved that shield to an apprentice.

12054.name: Jedi Knight
12054.text:
After setup, you may give this character 2 shields.
[special] - Give a character 1 shield. Then deal 1 damage to a character, or 2 damage instead if this character has 3 or more shields.

12055.name: Kanan Jarrus
12055.text: This character's point value is decreased by 1 if your team has another Spectre. After you activate this character, you may choose a symbol and a die. Then an opponent turns that die to a side not showing the chosen symbol.

12056.name: Luke Skywalker
12056.text: Piloting. The point value of your Death Star plot is decreased by 1. Before you resolve a support die of a vehicle piloted by this character, you may increase its value by 1.

12057.name: Forestall
12057.text: Turn up to 2 of your dice to sides showing a shield ([shield]).

12058.name: Fresh Start
12058.text: Remove a character die. Then discard cards from the top of a deck equal to the value showing on that die.

12059.name: Luminous Beings Are We
12059.text: Roll all of your defeated Jedi character dice into your pool. Set those dice aside after they have been resolved or removed.

12060.name: Nullify
12060.text: Move 1 shield from one of your characters to an opponent's character. Then remove a die.

12061.name: Skillful Deterrence
12061.text: For each elite character die in your pool, you may remove a die showing the same symbol as that die.

12062.name: Stand Firm
12062.text: Remove any number of your dice showing a shield ([shield]) to remove that many dice.

12063.name: Trust Your Feelings
12063.text: Reroll up to 2 of your dice. Then you may resolve one of your dice. Then you may use the action on your plot titled Destroy the Death Star for free.

12064.name: Valiant Deed
12064.text: Remove an upgrade die. Then you may spot a mission plot to roll an apprentice die on one of your characters into your pool.

12065.name: Jedi Trials
12065.text: Action - Spot an apprentice character that has 3 Blue abilities, 3 shields, and its character dice are showing a combined value of 3 or more. Then heal 3 damage from it, ready it, it gains Jedi and it gains 1 die (add a set-aside copy of its character die on it). Set this plot aside.

12066.name: Luke Skywalker's X-Wing
12066.text: Power Action - Reroll this die or, if Luke Skywalker is piloting this support, turn this die to any side.

12067.name: Anakin Skywalker's Lightsaber
12067.text:
Redeploy.
Discard this upgrade from play if you control Rey's Lightsaber.
After you play this upgrade, give a character you don't control 1 shield. Then give a character 2 shields.

12068.name: Kanan Jarrus' Lightsaber
12068.text: After an opponent's die is turned, you may turn this die to any side. Then, if this upgrade is on Kanan Jarrus, you may exhaust it to turn one of his character dice to any side.

12069.name: Padawan Braid
12069.text: Blue character only. Attached character gains apprentice and has +1 upgrade limit.

12070.name: Hera Syndulla
12070.text: Piloting. After this character begins piloting a vehicle, you may spend 2 resources to ready that vehicle.

12071.text: Before you resolve one of this character's character dice showing damage, increase its value by 1 if this character has 6 or more damage.

12072.name: Kazuda Xiono
12072.text: Piloting. After you activate this character, you may spend 1 resource to exhaust a vehicle.

12073.name: Poe Dameron
12073.text: Piloting. Power Action - Spot a vehicle that has no damage to place 1 damage on it. Then resolve its support die showing damage, increasing its value by 1, or by 2 instead if this character is piloting it.

12074.text: Each other Wookiee character you control has +1 health. Before you resolve one of this character's character dice showing damage, increase its value by 1 if this character has 6 or more damage.

12075.text: Spot a character that has 10 or more health to remove a die showing damage ([ranged], [melee], [indirect]), or up to 2 dice showing damage instead if that character has 15 or more health.

12076.name: Imposing Figure
12076.text: Gain 1 resource if you control the character that has the most health (including ties).

12077.name: Plan of Attack
12077.text: Turn one of your dice to any side. Then you may spot a card titled Death Star Plans to turn another one of your dice to any side.

12078.name: Run to Safety
12078.text: Heal 1 damage from a character. Then you may heal 2 damage from another character that shares a subtype with that character.

12079.text: Spot any number of characters that each have 10 or more health to roll one character die on each of them into your pool.

12080.name: Trench Run
12080.text: Activate one of your pilots and one of your vehicles. Then you may spot a Death Star plot to play a card titled Trust Your Feelings from your hand or discard pile.

12081.name: Destroy the Death Star
12081.text: After setup, give this plot 20 shields. You can resolve your pilot and vehicle dice showing ranged damage against this plot. Action - If this plot has no shields, spend 1 resource to reroll 1 of your pilot dice and 1 of your vehicle dice. Then, if both of those dice are showing damage, you win the game.

12082.name: Fireball
12082.text:
After resolve this die, place 1 damage on this support.
After this die rolls a blank ([blank]), if Kazuda Xiono is not piloting this support, remove all damage on it and deal that much indirect damage to yourself.

12083.name: Ghost
12083.text: Ambush. After this support enters play, you may activate a Spectre you control. After you resolve this die, you may give each character piloting this support 1 shield.

12084.name: Phantom
12084.text: Power Action - Spot Ghost to attach this support to it as a mod upgrade (it is no longer a support). Action - This upgrade becomes a support (Do not ready it. Return this die to its card).

12085.name: Rebel Hangar
12085.text: After you play this support, search your deck for up to 2 vehicles with a combined cost of 4 or less and play them for free. Shuffle your deck.

12086.name: Wookiee Protection
12086.text: Each of your Wookiee characters has Guardian. After you remove a die using Guardian, you may exhaust this support to draw a card.

12087.name: Fortitude
12087.text: Attached character has +3 health, or +4 health instead if it is a Wookiee.

12088.name: Master Smuggler
12088.text: After you activate this character, you may resolve one of your scoundrel dice as if it were showing a resource.

12089.name: Sabine Wren
12089.text:
Piloting.
[special] - Deal 2 indirect damage to an opponent, or 3 indirect damage instead if you have a Blue die, a Red die, and another Yellow die in your pool.

12090.name: Sinjir Rath Velus
12090.text: After you resolve one of this character's character dice, you may place a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck to remove a die showing the same symbol as that die.

12091.name: Torra Doza
12091.text: Piloting. After this character begins piloting a vehicle, you may resolve one of that vehicle's support or upgrade dice.

12092.name: Vengeful Wookiee
12092.text: Before you activate this character, you may reroll a die. Then you may remove a die if this character has 6 or more damage.

12093.name: As One
12093.text: Reroll a die. Then resolve up to 3 of your Spectre dice.

12094.name: Lead from the Front
12094.text:
Decrease the cost of this event by 1 for each different symbol showing on your dice.
Resolve up to 3 of your dice, increasing each of their values by 1.

12095.name: Loth-Cat and Mouse
12095.text: Force an opponent to remove one of your dice. Then remove one of their dice.

12096.name: Pride and Joy
12096.text: Play only if you control exactly one vehicle support. Resolve one of your vehicle dice without removing it.

12097.name: Reciprocate
12097.text: Ready an opponent's character. Then gain 1 resource.

12098.name: Blue Ace
12098.text:
Before you resolve this die, remove any number of resources from this support to increase its value by that number.
After you resolve this die, you may place 1 resource on this support.

12099.name: Bucket
12099.text: [special] - Gain 1 resource and either place 1 resource on a support or remove 1 damage fom a support.

12100.name: Sabine Wren's TIE Fighter
12100.text: Ambush. After this die modifies a Spectre die, you may discard a card from your hand to roll this die into your pool.

12101.name: Custom Paint Job
12101.text: Modify vehicle support. After you play this upgrade, choose a color. Attached vehicle and its die become that color. Then reroll up to 2 dice.

12102.name: Fling
12102.text: Spot a Wookiee character to exhaust another character that has less health than that Wookiee.

12103.name: Wookiee Rage
12103.text: Ambush. Until the end of the action phase, each "Before" ability on your Wookiee characters that contains "has 6 or more damage" now says "has 1 or more damage" instead..

12104.name: Spectre Cell
12104.text: Include only if each character on your team is a Spectre

12105.name: Valorous Tribe
12105.text: Action - Exhaust this plot to move up to 2 damage from a character to a character you control. Then you may spot a Wookiee to heal 1 damage from a character.

12106.name: Acute Awareness
12106.text: If a die was turned during an opponent's last turn this round, turn that die to any side.

12107.name: Bestow Wisdom
12107.text: Spot a Jedi or Sith to move up to 2 Blue abilities from that character to an apprentice character.

12108.name: Falling Avalanche
12108.text: Resolve one of your dice showing melee damage ([melee]), increasing its value by 3, or by 4 instead if it is a character or upgrade die belonging to a character that has a card titled Shien Mastery on it.

12109.name: Fluid Riposte
12109.text: Spot a Blue character to remove a die showing damage ([ranged], [melee], [indirect]). Then, if that character has a card titled Shien Mastery on it, deal 1 damage to a character.

12110.name: Infuse the Force
12110.text: Spot a Sith to deal 1 damage to a character. Spot a Jedi to give a character 1 shield. Spot an apprentice to draw a card.

12111.name: On Guard
12111.text:
Ambush.
Give a character 1 shield or spend 1 resource to ready an upgrade.

12112.name: Side By Side
12112.text: Reroll a die. Then you may remove a different die showing the same value as the die just rerolled.

12113.name: Seeking Knowledge
12113.text:
This support enters play with 2 resources on it.
After the action phase begins, remove 1 resource from this support. Then if no resources are on it, discard it to draw 3 cards.

12114.name: Shien Mastery
12114.text: Blue character only. Limit 1 form per character. After you play this upgrade, you may roll this die into your pool. [special] - Deal 2 damage to a character. You may remove a die showing damage.

12115.name: Shien Training
12115.text:
Blue character only.
[special] - Deal 2 damage to a character. You may discard this upgrade to play a card titled Shien Mastery from your hand or discard pile on attached character for free.

12117.name: Assail
12117.text: Ambush. Spot a piloted vehicle to remove a die.

12118.name: Command and Conquer
12118.text: Spot a pilot to activate it. Spot a leader to turn one of your character dice to any side. Spot a trooper to resolve one of your dice.

12119.name: Covert Mission
12119.text: Give a character 1 shield. Spot a mission plot to search your deck for a card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

12120.name: Embark
12120.text: Activate one of your characters or supports. Then, if you have 5 or more dice in your pool, turn one of them to a side with a symbol not showing on any of your dice.

12121.name: Flanked by Wingmen
12121.text: Activate one of your characters to give it 1 shield, or 2 shields instead if you spot 2 pilots.

12122.name: Joint Maneuver
12122.text: Resolve one of your vehicle dice showing damage ([ranged], [melee], or [indirect]), increasing its value by the number of characters piloting that vehicle.

12123.name: Sneak Attack
12123.text: Ambush. Play a Red vehicle from your hand for free. After the upkeep phase begins, if that vehicle is in play, return it to its owner's hand.

12124.name: Under Fire
12124.text: Deal 1 damage to a Red character you control. Then remove a die.

12125.name: Tactical Delay
12125.text:
This support enters play with 2 resources on it.
After the action phase begins, remove 1 resource from this support. Then if no resources are on it, discard it to gain 2 actions.

12126.name: Death Star Plans
12126.text: Action - Exhaust this upgrade to place 1 resource on or remove 2 shields from your Death Star plot. After an opponent's effect deals damage to attached character, they may move this card to one of their characters.

12127.name: Experimental Booster
12127.text: Modify vehicle support. After this die rolles a blank ([blank]), discard attached vehicle unless it is piloted.

12128.name: Licensed to Fly
12128.text: Attached character gains pilot and has Piloting.

12129.name: Nar Shaddaa Thief
12129.text: Power Action - If this character is exhausted and an opponent has at least 2 more resources than you, take 1 resource from them.

12130.name: Controlled Chaos
12130.text: Choose a symbol. then reroll up to 5 dice. You may spend 1 resource to reroll any number of those dice again. For each of those dice showing the chosen symbol, deal 1 indirect damage ([indirect]) to an opponent.

12131.name: Dangerous Escape
12131.text: Discard all downgrades on a character. Then deal damage to that character equal to the number of downgrades discarded this way.

12132.name: Deadlock
12132.text: Place 1 resource on a support you control. Place 1 resource on a support you do not control.

12133.name: Monopolize
12133.text:
Decrease the cost of this event by 1 for each opponent that has no resources.
Remove a die. Then if you have 3 or more resources, gain 1 resource.

12134.name: Reap
12134.text:
Ambush.
Turn one of your dice to a side showing a resource ([resource]).

12135.name: Rogue Tendencies
12135.text: Spot a scavenger to gain 1 resource. Spot a scoundrel to reroll up to 3 dice. Spot a bounty hunter to discard a random card from an opponent's hand.

12136.name: Survival Instinct
12136.text: Give control of the battlefield to an opponent. Then remove a die showing a value of 2 or less.

12137.name: Taken by Surprise
12137.text: Deal 1 damage to a ready character or spot a mission plot to deal 2 damage to a diceless character.

12138.name: Think on Your Feet
12138.text: Remove 1 resource from a non-plot card you control to remove a die showing damage ([ranged], [melee], or [indirect]).

12139.name: Coaxium Heist
12139.text: Include only if you bring a set-aside Pyke Sentinel ([CM]40) to the game. After set-up, add that character to an opponent's team. Action - If no opponent controls a Pyke Sentinel, set this plot aside and remove 4 of your dice each showing different symbols to gain 10 resources.

12140.name: Cloud Car
12140.text: Action - Play this vehicle for free from your hand. After the upkeep phase begins, give control of this support to an opponent.

12141.name: Double Agent
12141.text: After the upkeep phase begins, deal 2 indirect damage ([indirect]) to yourself. Action - Discard an event from your hand to give control of this support to an opponent.

12142.name: Improvised Explosive
12142.text:
This support enters play with 2 resources on it.
After the action phase begins, remove 1 resource from this support. Then if no resources are on it, discard it to deal 3 indirect damage ([indirect]) to a player.

12143.name: Raiding Party
12143.text: After you activate this support, you may remove 1 resource from a support or upgrade in play. Then gain 1 resource.

12144.name: Repurposing
12144.text: Action - Exhaust this support and set aside an equipment or weapon from an opponent's discard pile to play an equipment or weapon from your hand, decreasing its cost by 1.

12145.name: Magna-Glove
12145.text: [special] - Spend resources equal to the cost of an opponent's equipment or weapon upgrade in play to move it to attached character. Then spot a scavenger to roll that upgrade's die into your pool.

12146.name: Z-6 Jetpack
12146.text:
This upgrade enters play with 1 resource on it.
[special] - Place 1 resource on this upgrade. Then deal indirect damage to an opponent equal to the number of resources on this upgrade.

12147.name: Jawa Junk Dealer
12147.text: After you activate this character, you may play a Gray neutral card from your hand, decreasing its cost by 1.

12148.name: Outdated Tech
12148.text: Modify opponent's vehicle support. Before attached vehicle's support die is resolved, you may reduce its value by 1.

12149.name: Eject
12149.text: Ambush. Discard a vehicle you control to heal 2 damage from one of its piloting characters and give that character 2 shields.

12150.name: Harmless Trick
12150.text: Spot a Gray character to remove a die.

12151.name: Salvaged Parts
12151.text: Set aside 2 non-event cards from a discard pile. Then spot a scavenger to gain 1 resource.

12153.name: Utinni!
12153.text: Spot up to 4 Jawa characters to discard that many cards from the top of a deck.

12154.name: Merchant Freighter
12154.text:
This support enters play with 3 resources on it.
This support can be activated.
After you activate this support, you may remove 1 resource from it to gain 1 resource.

12155.name: Sandcrawler
12155.text:
This support enters play exhausted.
