08155.text:
Include only if you have no hero or villain characters on your team.
Each of your neutral characters has +1 health.

08156.name: Solidarity
08156.text: Include only if each character on your team is the same color and your deck contains no more than one copy of any card.

08157.name: Landing Dock
08157.text: After any player plays a vehicle, that player may take control of this battlefield. Power Action - Reroll a die.

08158.name: Occupied City
08158.text: After an opponent plays a support or an upgrade, you may discard the top card of their deck.

08159.name: Theed Royal Palace
08159.text: Power Action - Remove one of your dice to gain 1 resource. Spot a neutral character to take one additional action.

08160.name: Training Room
08160.text: Power Action - Reroll any number of your non-unique character dice.

09001.name: Asajj Ventress
09001.text: After a character that has a downgrade on it takes damage from this die, you may discard a card from your hand to remove one of that character's character or upgrade dice.

09002.name: Palpatine
09002.text: This character has +1 health for each ability on it and those abilities do not count toward its upgrade limit. Power Action - Roll a die on an ability on this character into your pool.

09003.name: Sentinel Messenger
09003.text: You cannot play Blue abilities on this character. After you activate this character, look at the top card of your deck. You may play that card (paying its cost).

09004.name: Sly Moore
09004.text: After you activate this character, you may reroll one of your Sith dice. [special] - Turn a die to a side showing a blank ([blank]) and discard a random card from an opponent's hand.

09005.name: Mind Extraction
09005.text: Attached character loses all of its non-special ([special]) abilities. Action - Exhaust attached character to discard this downgrade. Only attached character's controller can use this action.

09006.name: A Tale of Tragedy
09006.text: Spot a Sith to turn another character's character dice to the sides of your choice.

09007.name: Breaking Bonds
09007.text: Choose a character and discard a downgrade from it. If that character is a Sith, you may turn a die to a side showing a blank ([blank]).

09008.name: Fit of Rage
09008.text: Remove all shields from all opponents' characters.

09009.name: Forsaken
09009.text:
Play only if a player has exactly one die in their pool.
Remove a die showing a value of 2 or less.

09010.name: Isolation
09010.text: Spot a Blue character to remove a character die.

09011.name: No Mercy
09011.text: Discard any number of Blue cards from your hand. Then resolve one of your dice showing damage ([ranged], [melee], or [indirect]), increasing its value by 1 for each card you discarded.

09012.name: Forbidden Lore
09012.text: Before you play a Blue ability, you may discard this support from play to decrease its cost by 1. Then you may spot a Sith to draw a card.

09013.name: Imperialis
09013.text:
After you activate Palpatine, you may activate this support.
[special] - Discard this support from play to deal 4 indirect damage ([indirect]) to an opponent.

09014.name: Force Storm
09014.text:
Blue character only.
[special] - Exhaust this upgrade to place 1 resource on it. Deal damage to a character equal to the number of resources on this upgrade. Reroll this die instead of removing it.

09015.name: Malice
09015.text:
Redeploy.
[special] - Deal 1 damage to any number of characters that have one or more of their character dice showing a blank ([blank]).

09016.name: Palpatine's Lightsaber
09016.text: After you play this upgrade, gain resources equal to the number of ability upgrades on attached character, to a maximum of 2. While this upgrade is on Palpatine, your copies of it are non-unique.

09017.name: Sith Teachings
09017.text: Play only if you spot a Sith. After you play this upgrade, you may remove a die showing a blank. [special] - Deal 1 damage to a character, or 2 damage instead if you removed an opponent's die this round.

09018.name: Captain Phasma
09018.text: You may resolve your trooper dice showing damage as if they were melee damage ([melee]). Power Action - Roll 2 set-aside First Order Stormtrooper ([CONV]20) dice into your pool. Set those dice aside after they are resolved or removed.

09019.name: Commando Droid
09019.text: After you activate this character, you may activate one of your droid characters or supports.

09021.name: General Grievous
09021.text: While building your team, the point value of each droid is decreased by 1. Power Action - Reroll any number of your droid dice.

09022.name: Wat Tambor
09022.text: Power Action - Play a Red support from your hand (paying its cost). Then roll that support's die into your pool.

09023.name: A Sinister Peace
09023.text: Discard a card from your hand to remove a die showing a value of 2 or more.

09024.name: Make Demands
09024.text: Spot a leader to choose an opponent's character and deal 2 damage to it unless they give you 1 of their resources.

09025.name: Probe
09025.text: Look at 2 random cards in an opponent's hand and discard each of those cards that is an event.

09026.name: Pulverize
09026.text: Resolve up to 3 of your dice showing damage ([ranged], [melee] or [indirect]) in the order of your choice, increasing each of their values by 1.

09027.name: Roger, Roger
09027.text: Spot a Red character to turn up to 2 of your droid dice to the sides of your choice.

09028.name: The Best Defense...
09028.text: Deal one of your Red characters 3 damage to remove up to 2 of an opponent's dice.

09029.name: Defoliator Tank
09029.text: [special] - Deal 3 damage to each character that is not a droid or General Grievous.

09030.name: Imperial Officer
09030.text: After you activate this support, you may turn one of your trooper dice to any side.

09031.name: Megablaster Troopers
09031.text: After you activate this support, roll 1 set-aside First Order Stormtrooper ([CONV]20) die into your pool, or 2 First Order Stormtrooper dice instead if you spot a leader. Set those dice aside after they are resolved or removed.

09033.name: E-5 Blaster Carbine
09033.text: While this upgrade is on a droid, it has Redeploy.

09034.name: Modular Frame
09034.text: Redeploy. Attached character has +1 health. Discard this upgrade from play if it is not on a droid or on General Grievous.

09035.name: Dengar
09035.text: After you activate this character, you may deal 1 damage to a character that has a bounty on it.

09036.name: Jabba The Hutt
09036.text: After you activate this character, you may look at the top 4 cards of your deck, reveal a bounty or a Yellow event from among them, and add it to your hand. Place the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

09037.name: Quarren Tracker
09037.text: [special] - Deal 2 damage to a character or deal 3 damage to a character that has a bounty on it.

09038.name: Watto
09038.text: This character's character dice cannot be removed by opponents' Blue events. Power Action - Spend 1 resource and choose a symbol to reroll a die. If it rolls the chosen symbol, gain 2 resources.

09039.name: Death Mark
09039.text: After attached character is defeated, you may draw 3 cards.

09040.name: Enticing Reward
09040.text: After attached character is defeated, you may play an equipment or a weapon from your hand or discard pile for free.

09041.name: Barter With Blood
09041.text: Each player hides any number of tokens from the supply in their hand, then reveals them. Each player who revealed the highest number of tokens is dealt that much indirect damage and may play a card from their hand for free.

09042.name: Conveyex Robbery
09042.text: Spot a scoundrel to choose one die in each opponents' pools. Resolve those dice in the order of your choice as if they were in your pool.

09043.name: Exterminate
09043.text: Each opponent chooses a character subtype. Then remove all opponents' character dice that do not have a chosen subtype.

09044.name: Fight Dirty
09044.text: Remove any number of your Yellow dice. Then deal damage to a character equal to the number of dice you just removed.

09045.name: Hard Bargain
09045.text: Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. An opponent discards one of those cards, then you may play one of the other cards for free. Discard the remaining cards.

09046.name: Hunt Them Down
09046.text: Resolve one of your dice showing ranged or melee damage ([ranged] or [melee]) against a character, increasing its value by the number of bounty downgrades on that character.

09047.name: Bounty Board
09047.text: Action - Exhaust this support to search your deck for a bounty, reveal it, and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

09048.name: Punishing One
09048.text: After an opponent's character that has a bounty on it is defeated, you may ready this support. If you spot Dengar, you may activate this support.

09049.name: Crime Lord
09049.text:
Yellow Character only.
[special] - Spend 5 resources to choose a character. Before this round ends, defeat that character.

09050.name: Dengar's Fire Blade
09050.text: After you play this upgrade, you may deal 1 damage to a character that has a bounty on it. Power Action - If this upgrade is on Dengar, turn one of his character dice to a side showing a value of 1.

09051.name: Skilled Tracker
09051.text:
Yellow character only.
[special] - Remove a character die.

09052.name: Separatist Conspiracy
09052.text: Action - Exhaust this plot and spot any number of leader characters to draw that many cards, unless an opponent spends 1 resource or discards a card from their hand.

09053.name: Assassin Droid
09053.text: After you roll this die into your pool, you may deal 1 damage to a character.

09054.name: Ahsoka Tano
09054.text: After you activate a Jedi, you may resolve one of this character's character or upgrade dice. If that die is showing a modifier, resolve it as if it did not have a modifier.

09055.name: Lor San Tekka
09055.text: Power Action - Choose 3 cards from your discard pile. Then an opponent adds one of those cards to your hand. Set the other 2 cards aside.

09056.name: Mace Windu
09056.text: Power Action - Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may play an upgrade from among them. Place the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order. If that upgrade was played on a Jedi, give it 1 shield.

09057.name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
09057.text: Power Action - Resolve one of your dice showing a value of 2 or more, increasing its value by 1.

09058.name: Vigilant Jedi
09058.text: [special] - Remove a die showing damage ([ranged], [melee] or [indirect]). Then deal 1 damage to a character.

09059.name: A Friend Lost
09059.text:
Play only if you have one or more defeated unique characters.
Turn up to 2 of your dice to sides showing damage ([ranged], [melee] or [indirect]).

09060.name: Channel the Force
09060.text: Reroll a die. You may spot a leader to turn a die to any side. You may spot a Jedi to remove a die.

09062.name: Disciplined Mind
09062.text: Spot a Jedi to remove a non-Jedi die.

09063.name: Strong Intuition
09063.text: Draw 3 cards, then discard a card from your hand.

09064.name: Upper Hand
09064.text: Play only if you have one or more dice showing a value of 2 or more. Remove a die showing a value of 0 (blanks and specials have a value of 0).

09065.name: Obi-Wan Kenobi's Interceptor
09065.text: After you activate this support, you may spot Obi-Wan Kenobi to turn one of your dice showing a blank ([blank]) to any side.

09066.name: Uneti Force Tree
09066.text: Action - Exhaust this support to choose another player. Then, you and that player each draw a card.

09067.name: Yoda's Spirit
09067.text:
Discard this support from play if you have Yoda in play.
[special] - Shuffle this support into its owner's deck to deal 3 unblockable damage to a character.

09068.name: Jedi Holocron
09068.text: Play only if you spot a Jedi. [special] - Place this upgrade on the bottom of its owner's deck to draw 3 cards. You may play a Blue ability from your hand, decreasing its cost by 1.

09069.name: Lore Hunter
09069.text: After you activate attached character, you may look at the top 2 cards of a player's deck, discard one of those cards, then add the other card to that player's hand.

09070.name: Mace Windu's Lightsaber
09070.text: Power Action - Spot Mace Windu to move this upgrade to him. [special] - Deal 2 unblockable damage to a character. Then, if that character has 1 remaining health, defeat it.

09071.name: Republic Jedi Armor
09071.text: After you play this upgrade on a Jedi, give it 1 shield. Attached character has +1 health.

09072.name: K-2SO
09072.text: After this character is defeated, you may end the action phase. Power Action - Reroll one of your dice. Then reroll up to a number of dice equal to the value showing on the die just rerolled.

09073.name: Kes Dameron
09073.text: Action - Resolve any number of your trooper dice in the order of your choice.

09074.name: Naboo Palace Guard
09074.text: While you have a leader in play, this character gains Guardian.

09075.name: Padmé Amidala
09075.text: You may resolve your dice showing a focus ([focus]) as if they were indirect damage ([indirect]).

09076.name: Target Acquired
09076.text:
Damaged character only.
Indirect damage ([indirect]) assigned by attached character's controller must be assigned to attached character, if able.

09077.name: Aggressive Negotiations
09077.text: Choose an opponent and have them remove any number of their dice.  Then deal 2 indirect damage ([indirect]) to that opponent for each of their dice showing damage ([ranged], [melee], or [indirect]).

09079.name: Honorable Sacrifice
09079.text: Defeat one of your characters to remove up to 2 dice showing damage ([ranged], [melee], or [indirect]).

09080.name: Power Surge
09080.text: Resolve one of your dice showing damage ([ranged], [melee], or [indirect]), doubling its value, to a maximum value of 6.

09081.name: Unfetter
09081.text: Ready a Red character that has no cards attached to it.

09082.name: A-Wing
09082.text: After you activate this support, you may discard a card from your hand to resolve any number of its support and upgrade dice in the order of your choice.

09083.name: Concerted Effort
09083.text: After you resolve a die, if you have resolved 3 or more dice this turn, you may exhaust this support to deal 1 damage to a character.

09084.name: LAAT Gunship
09084.text: [special] - Roll a trooper die on one of your cards in play into your pool and resolve it. Otherwise, remove it. Reroll this support's die instead of removing it.

09085.name: Padmé Amidala's Royal Starship
09085.text: After you activate this support, you may give a leader character 1 shield. If that leader is Padmé Amidala, activate her.

09087.name: Resistance Ring
09087.text: After you play this upgrade, discard the top card of a deck. [special] - Play a Red event from any discard pile as if it were yours (paying its cost), then set that event aside.

09088.name: Chewbacca
09088.text: While you have another scoundrel in play, this character has Guardian. Before you resolve one of this character's character dice showing damage, increase its value by 1 if this character has 6 or more damage.

09089.name: Ezra Bridger
09089.text:
You may play Blue upgrades on this character, ignoring play restrictions.
You may resolve dice in player's pool that has used the Claim the Battlefield action this round as if they were in your pool.

09090.name: Maz Kanata
09090.text: Power Action - An opponent chooses and does 1. You choose and do 2 others: • Deal 1 indirect damage ([indirect]) to a player. • Turn an opponent's die to any side. • Reroll any number of your dice. • Draw a card.

09091.name: Satine Kryze
09091.text: After you activate this character, you may reroll one of your dice.

09092.name: Calculated Risk
09092.text: Reroll a die. Then, if that die is showing a value of 2 or more, gain 1 resource.

09093.name: Convergence
09093.text: Spot any number of characters that have the same subtype to discard a support, upgrade, or downgrade that costs that number from play.

09094.name: Draw Attention
09094.text: Move up to 2 damage from one of your characters to another one of your characters (this ignores shields).

09095.name: Flee the Scene
09095.text: Remove up to 2 dice. You must pass your next 2 turns this round.

09096.name: Instigate
09096.text:
Ambush.
Activate one of your characters or supports.

09097.name: Reap the Reward
09097.text: Spot a scoundrel to resolve one of your character or upgrade dice. Then gain resources equal to the value that the die was just resolved for.

09098.name: Sure Shot
09098.text: Resolve one of your dice showing ranged damage ([ranged]) against a character, then remove one of that character's character or upgrade dice.

09099.name: We're Home
09099.text: Activate one of your Yellow vehicles and up to 2 of your scoundrels. You may remove one of your dice showing a resource ([resource]) to ready that vehicle.

09100.name: Laser Tripwire
09100.text: After a player activates a character, if 2 or more of that character's character or upgrade dice are showing damage ([ranged], [melee], or [indirect]), discard this support from play to deal 3 indirect damage ([indirect]) to that player.

09101.name: Rebel Cache
09101.text: After you roll one or more dice showing a resource ([resource]), you may place 1 resource on this support. [special] - Take up to 2 resources from this support, or 3 resources instead if you spot a scoundrel.

09102.name: Chewbacca's Blaster Rifle
09102.text: After you play this upgrade, you may deal 1 damage to attached character to roll this die into your pool. Then, if that character is Chewbacca, you may resolve this die.

09103.name: Custom Bandolier
09103.text: Each equipment on attached character does not count towards its upgrade limit Action - Exhaust this upgrade to reroll one of your equipment or weapon dice.

09104.name: Moxie
09104.text: [special] - Use a special ability ([special]) or a power action on attached character, even if it was used this round.

09105.name: Secrets Laid Bare
09105.text: After attached character is activated, reveal 3 random cards from its controller's hand.

09106.name: Attunement
09106.text: If you have a die showing (do all that apply): • Melee ([melee]) - Deal 1 damage to a character. • Shield ([shield]) - Give 1 shield to a character. • Blank ([blank]) - You may turn a die to a blank.

09107.name: Circle of Shelter
09107.text: Resolve one of your character dice as if it were showing a shield ([shield]). If that character has a card titled Soresu Mastery on it, that die is resolved without removing it from your pool.

09108.name: Deflecting Slash
09108.text: Activate one of your Blue characters to remove a die showing ranged or indirect damage ([ranged] or [indirect]). If that character has a card titled Soresu Mastery on it, give it 2 shields.

09109.name: Fatal Blow
09109.text: Resolve one of your character dice showing damage ([ranged], [melee] or [indirect]), increasing its value by the number of upgrades on that character.

09110.name: Overqualified
09110.text: Choose one of your dice. Then remove a die showing a value less than the chosen die.

09111.name: Twin Strike
09111.text: Resolve up to 2 of your Blue character dice showing melee damage ([melee]) as unblockable.

09112.name: Use The Force
09112.text: Spot a Blue character to turn a die to any side.

09113.name: Force Flow
09113.text: Action - Set this plot aside to turn a die to any side.

09114.name: Lightsaber Mastery
09114.text: Bring up to 2 different move events to the game and place them facedown under this plot (ignoring deckbuilding restrictions). Action - Exhaust this plot to play an event from under it, then set that event aside.

09115.name: Diatium Power Cell
09115.text: Before you resolve a weapon die showing damage ([ranged], [melee] or [indirect]) that has the word "Lightsaber" in its title, you may exhaust this support to increase its value by 1.

09116.name: It Binds All Things
09116.text: Before you play a Blue upgrade, you may exhaust this support to decrease its cost by 1.

09117.name: Force Pull
09117.text:
Blue character only.
[special] - Choose an opponent's character and force them to activate it. Then you may resolve one of that character's character dice as if it were in your pool.

09118.name: Lightsaber
09118.text:
Redeploy.
[special] - Deal 2 unblockable damage to a character.

09119.name: Soresu Mastery
09119.text: Blue character only. Limit 1 form per character. After you play this upgrade, you may remove a die showing damage. [special] - Remove a die showing damage and give a character 1 shield.

09120.name: Soresu Training
09120.text:
Blue character only.
[special] - Give a character 2 shields. You may discard this upgrade to play a card titled Soresu Mastery from your hand or discard pile on attached character for free.

09121.name: Hampered
09121.text: No more than one of attached character's character dice can be resolved during each turn and those dice cannot be modified.

09122.name: Automated Defense
09122.text: Spot a droid to remove a die.

09124.name: Energize
09124.text: Roll a droid die on one of your characters or supports in play into your pool.

09125.name: Forced Compliance
09125.text: Turn an opponent's die to any side. Then turn one of your dice to a side showing the same symbol as that die.

09126.name: Fresh Supplies
09126.text:
Play only if you control the battlefield.
Gain 1 resource.

09127.name: Measure for Measure
09127.text: Remove one of your trooper dice to remove a die.

09128.name: No Answer
09128.text: Discard a random card from an opponent's hand. Then, if that opponent has no cards in hand, discard the top 3 cards of their deck.

09129.name: Rout
09129.text: For every 3 dice in your pool, you may remove a die.

09130.name: Seize the Day
09130.text:
Play only if you control the battlefield.
Gain 2 actions.

09131.name: Squad Tactics
09131.text: Activate any number of your non-unique characters at once.

09132.name: Strike Back
09132.text: If you have a die showing (do all that apply): • Ranged ([ranged]) - Deal 1 damage to a character. • Focus ([focus]) - Turn one of your dice to any side. • Discard ([discard]) - Discard a random card from a player's hand.

09133.name: Advanced Training
09133.text: You may resolve your trooper dice showing a blank ([blank]) as if they were indirect damage ([indirect]) that have a value of 1.

09134.name: Conscript Squad
09134.text: After you activate a leader, you may activate this support.

09135.name: Press the Advantage
09135.text: Action - Exhaust this support to reroll one of your dice. Then, if you have more dice in your pool than an opponent has in their pool, you may reroll a die (yours or an opponent's).

09136.name: Tech Team
09136.text: Before you play a support, you may exhaust this support to decrease its cost by 1.

09137.name: V-Wing
09137.text: While a villain vehicle die is in your pool, decrease the cost on this die by 1. While a hero vehicle die is in your pool, this die cannot be removed by opponents.

09139.name: Quicksilver Baton
09139.text: After you play this upgrade, if it is on a leader, roll this die into your pool. If this upgrade is on a trooper, you may spend 1 resource to roll one of that trooper's character dice into your pool.

09140.name: Riot Shield
09140.text: Before attached character takes damage, you may discard this upgrade to block 2 damage, or 3 damage instead if attached character is a trooper.

09141.name: Enfys Nest
09141.text: You can include up to 2 villain cards and up to 2 hero cards in your deck (following other deckbuilding restrictions). Power Action - Resolve up to 3 of your scoundrel dice showing the same symbol for free.

09142.name: Enfys Nest's Marauder
09142.text: You can include up to 1 villain card and up to 1 hero card in your deck (following other deckbuilding restrictions). After you resolve this die showing a cost, you may deal 1 indirect ([indirect]) damage to an opponent.

09143.name: Wanted
09143.text: After attached character is defeated, you may gain 2 resources.

09144.name: Electroshock
09144.text: Spot a yellow character to remove a die showing a value of 2 or less.

09145.name: For a Price
09145.text: Turn a character die to a side showing a cost.

09146.name: Prey Upon
09146.text: Choose a character that has a downgrade on it and remove one of its character or upgrade dice.

09147.name: Rendezvous
09147.text:
Ambush.
Resolve one of your Yellow dice showing a cost, decreasing its cost by 1.

09148.name: Skullduggery
09148.text: If you have a die showing (do all that apply): • Indirect ([indirect]) - Deal 1 indirect damage to an opponent. • Disrupt ([disrupt]) - Force a player to lose 1 resource. • Resource ([resource]) - Gain 1 resource.

09150.name: Unpredictable
09150.text: Ambush. Reroll a die (yours or an opponent's).

09151.name: Profiteering
09151.text: After one of your scoundrel dice rolls a side showing a resource ([resource]), you may resolve it.

09152.name: Entourage
09152.text: After you play this support, you may search your deck for a scoundrel, reveal it, and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. [special] - Spot any number of scoundrels to deal that much damage to a character.

09153.name: Seeking The Truth
09153.text: Action - Exhaust this support to reroll one of your dice. Then you may spot a leader to reroll a die (yours or an opponent's).

09154.name: Smuggling Ring
09154.text: Action - Exhaust this support to gain 1 resource and gain 1 action.

09155.name: Starviper
09155.text: Ambush. [special] - Deal 3 damage to a character, or discard a vehicle that costs 3 or less from play.

09156.name: Enfys Nest's Electroripper
09156.text: [special] - Deal 1 unblockable damage to each of an opponent's characters. If this upgrade is on Enfys Nest, remove one of that opponent's character dice.

09157.name: Mandalorian Jetpack
09157.text: [special] - Reroll another die. Then deal damage to a character equal to the value showing on that die.

09158.name: Ordnance Launcher
09158.text: Ambush. (After you play this card, gain 1 action.) After you resolve a scoundrel die, you may resolve this die as if it did not have a modifier.

09159.name: Unscrupulous
09159.text: Scoundrel character only. [special] - Discard a random card from an opponent's hand or force an opponent to lose 1 resource.

09160.name: Shock Collar
09160.text: After attached character is activated, deal 1 damage to it.

09162.name: Bacta Therapy
09162.text: Heal damage from a character equal to the number of upgrades on it, to a maximum of 5. Discard each injury on that character.

09163.name: Block
09163.text: Remove all of an opponent's dice showing melee damage ([melee]).

09164.name: Dodge
09164.text: Remove all of an opponent's dice showing ranged damage ([ranged]).

09166.name: Near Miss
09166.text: Spot 2 characters that share a subtype to remove a die.

09167.name: Unshackle
09167.text:
Ambush.
Discard a downgrade from play.

09168.name: Fickle Mercenaries
09168.text: Action - Spend 2 resources to take control of this support (return its die to this card). Any player may use this action.

09169.name: Grievance Striker
09169.text:
Redeploy.
After you play this upgrade on General Grievous or on Obi-Wan Kenobi, you may deal 1 damage to a character.

09170.name: Protective Suit
09170.text: Non-bounty downgrades cannot be played on attached character. Action - Return this upgrade from play to your hand.

09172.name: Sonic Detonators
09172.text:
After you play this upgrade, place 6 resources on it.
[special] - Remove any number of resources from this upgrade to choose that many characters and deal 2 damage to each of them.

09173.name: Command Center
09173.text: Claim - Each opponent discards the top 2 cards of their deck.

09174.name: Deathwatch Hideout
09174.text: Claim - Gain 1 resource. Spot Satine Kryze to place a card from your discard pile on the bottom of your deck.

09175.name: Fighting Pit
09175.text: Power Action - Reroll an opponent's character die. Reroll one of your character dice. Then deal damage to those characters equal to the value showing on the other character's die.

09176.name: Lair of General Grievous
09176.text: Claim - Deal 1 indirect damage ([indirect]) to an opponent unless they give you 1 of their resources, or spot general Grievous to deal 1 damage to a character.

09177.name: Mean Streets
09177.text: Claim - You may spot a scoundrel to place 1 resource on this battlefield. You may play an event from your hand, decreasing its cost by the number of resources on this battlefield.

09178.name: Military Camp
09178.text: Power Action - Activate up to 2 of your characters that share a subtype. If one of those characters is a trooper, you may reroll one of its character dice.

09179.name: Salt Flats
09179.text: Power Action - Turn a die to a side showing a blank ([blank]) or turn one of your leader dice to any side.

09180.name: Watto's Shop
09180.text: Claim - Discard one of your supports or upgrades from play to gain resources equal to its cost.

13001A.name: Anakin Skywalker
13001A.text:
Parallel die Anakin Skywalker ([CM]53).
After you activate this character, deal 1 damage to him and 2 damage to another character. Then, if that character was just defeated, flip this character.

13001B.name: Darth Vader
13001B.text: Parallel die Darth Vader ([AW]10). Power Action - Either remove all shields from a character, or resolve one of your dice as melee damage, increasing its value by 1. If an opponent has a defeated character, you may do both in any order.

13002A.name: Luke Skywalker
13002A.text:
Parallel die Luke Skywalker ([LEG]31).
Team Up 1: Obi-Wan Kenobi, Yoda.
After the upkeep phase begins, if this character has 3 or more shields and 3 or more Blue upgrades with dice, you may spend 2 resources to flip him.

13002B.name: Luke Skywalker
13002B.text: Parallel die Luke Skywalker ([AW]35). Power Action - Either give this character 2 shields, or remove 2 shields from him to deal 2 damage to a character. If this character has 3 or more Blue upgrades, you may do both in any order.

13003A.name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
13003A.text: Guardian. After this character is defeated, return him to play flipped and ready. Action - Spot another Blue character to remove a die showing damage. Defeat this character and, if he is elite, remove up to 3 dice.

13003B.name: Obi-Wan Kenobi's Spirit
13003B.text: Parallel die One With the Force ([AW]42). If this support would leave play, set it aside instead. Power Action - Give a Blue character 1 shield and reroll any number of its character and upgrade dice.

13004A.name: Sweeper Droid Infiltration
13004A.text: After setup, if this plot is elite, add an additional copy of it to your team. Action - Play an event from your hand to reroll a die. Then flip this plot.

13004B.name: Demolition Droid
13004B.text: Action - Play a non-event card from your hand to deal 1 indirect damage to an opponent. If 2 or more bomb plots are in play, you may set them all aside and deal 4 indirect damage to an opponent. If you do not, flip this plot.

13005A.name: Send in the Troopers
13005A.text: Action - If you control the battlefield and 5 or more dice in your pool are showing damage, force an opponent to name a character. Then flip this plot. If they did not name this character, make it elite.

13005B.name: Arc Trooper Echo
13005B.text: After you activate this character, if it is elite, you may roll a character die on a character into its controler's pool. If you control the battlefield, you may roll a character die on a character into its controller's pool.

13005C.name: Arc Trooper Fives
13005C.text:
After you activate this character, roll a Clone Trooper ([LEG]38) die into your pool, or 2 Clone Trooper dice instead if this character is elite.
After a Clone Trooper die is rolled into your pool, you may reroll it. If you control the battlefield, you may reroll it again.

13005D.name: Clone Commander Wolffe
13005D.text: After you activate this character, you may roll a Clone Trooper ([LEG]38) die into your pool and activate one of your Red characters. If this character is elite and you control the battlefield, spot any number of unique Red characters to deal that much indirect damage to an opponent.

13006A.name: Closing In
13006A.text: Team Up 1: Each unique bounty hunter. After you deal melee or ranged damage to a character with a bounty on it, you may exhaust this plot and flip it to attach it to that character.

13006B.name: Captured
13006B.text: If this downgrade would leave play, set it aside instead. Attached character cannot be activated. Action - Give the player that controls this downgrade 1 resource to flip it. Any player may use this ability.

13007A.name: Rescue Han Solo
13007A.text: Team Up 1: Chewbacca, Lando Calrissian, Leia Organa, Luke Skywalker. Action - Play a card from your hand with a cost equal to the number of resources on this plot. Its cost cannot be decreased. Then place 1 resource on this plot and if it has 5 resources, flip it and exhaust it.

13007B.name: Han Solo
13007B.text:
Piloting. Parallel die Han Solo ([AW]46).
After you activate this character, remove 1 resource from him to gain 1 resource.
After this character is defeated, lose all of your resources. Each opponent gains that many resources.

13008A.name: Choose Your Destiny
13008A.text:
Infinite format only. Choose 3 sets. You can only include other cards on your team and in your deck from those sets.
After you play a card, if you played cards from all 3 sets this round, flip this plot.

13008B.name: I Will Not Turn
13008B.text:
Your dice cannot be turned by opponents.
Before the round ends, gain 1 resource.
After an opponent plays a card, if they played cards from 3 different sets this round, flip this plot.

13009A.name: United
13009A.text:
Include only if each character on your team is the same color.
After an opponent removes one of your dice, you may roll it into your pool. Then set this plot aside, or if it's elite, flip it instead.

13009B.name: We Stand
13009B.text: After an opponent removes one of your character dice, you may spend 2 resources and discard 2 cards from your hand to ready that character. Then set this plot aside.

13010A.name: Mortis (Day)
13010A.text: After the upkeep phase begins, heal 1 damage from each character. Flip this card. Claim - Heal 1 damage from a character. You may flip this card.

13010B.name: Mortis (Night)
13010B.text: After the upkeep phase begins, deal 1 damage to each character. Flip this card. Claim - Deal 1 damage to a character. You may flip this card.

15003A.name: Maul
15003A.text: After you play an event, place 1 resource on this card. If this character has 7 or more resources on it, you may spend 2 resources to flip this card.

15003B.name: Maul
15003B.text: After you play an event, place 1 resource on this card. Power Action - Play a Blue event with an even cost from your hand, decreasing its cost by 1. [special] - Gain 2 resources or resolve any die. If this character has 7 or more resources on it, you may do both in any order.

15004A.name: Savage Opress
15004A.text: Team Up 1: Maul. Guardian. Power Action - Discard a card from your hand and spend 3 resources. Then flip this character.

15004B.name: Savage Opress
15004B.text:
Guardian.
[special] - Deal 2 damage to a character or turn a die to a side showing a value of 0. If this character has 6 or more damage, you may do both in any order.

15010A.name: Watch Your Career With Great Interest
15010A.text: After you turn or remove a die, place 1 resource on this plot. Action - Defeat one of your Sith or apprentice characters and remove 6 resources from this plot. Then, if the defeated character was elite, this plot becomes elite. Flip this plot.

15010B.name: Darth Vader
15010B.text: [special] - Play an ability from your hand or discard pile, decreasing its cost by 2. Then roll that ability's die into your pool.

15092A.name: The Ultimate Heist
15092A.text: Team Up 1: Each pirate. After one of your effects causes an opponent to lose 1 or more resources, place resources on this plot equal to the number of resources lost. If this plot has 4 or more resources, spot a pirate character to flip this card and attach it to that character.

15092B.name: Master of Pirates
15092B.text: Power Action - Take 1 resource from an opponent. [special] - Give an opponent 1 of your resources. Then resolve any die (yours or an opponent's) and gain 1 action.

16002A.name: Darth Momin
16002A.text: After this character is defeated, return him to play flipped, ready and attach it to one of your characters. Power Action - Play a Blue ability from your hand, reducing its cost by 1 if an opponent has one or more dice showing a blank.

16002B.name: Mask Of Momin
16002B.text: This upgrade cannot be replaced. Power Action - Deal 1 damage to attached character. Play a Blue ability from your discard pile, reducing its cost by 1 if an opponent has one or more dice showing a blank.

16039A.name: Grogu
16039A.text: After this character is defeated, return it to play flipped and give control of it to an opponent. After you activate this character, deal 1 damage to it and search your deck for a Blue ability. Discard it and roll its die into your pool. Set that die aside after it is resolved or removed. Shuffle your deck.

16039B.name: Force Experiments
16039B.text: After one of your characters is defeated, flip this card and give control of it to an opponent. Power Action - Set aside a Blue ability from a discard pile to roll its die into your pool. Set that die aside after it is resolved or removed.

20136A.name: Mortis (Day)
20136A.text: After the upkeep phase begins, heal 1 damage from each character. Flip this card. Claim - Heal 1 damage from a character. You may flip this card.

20136B.name: Mortis (Night)
20136B.text: After the upkeep phase begins, deal 1 damage to each character. Flip this card. Claim - Deal 1 damage to a character. You may flip this card.

21005A.name: Snoke
21005A.text: After this character is defeated, return him to play flipped and ready. If this character is elite, make it elite. Power Action - Deal 1 damage to this character to roll a die on an ability on this character into your pool.

21005B.name: Sith Citadel Laboratory
21005B.text:
This support enters play with 2 resources on it.
After the action phase ends, remove 1 resource from this support. Then, if there are no resources on this support, place 5 damage on this support and flip it.

21045A.name: Rey
21045A.text: Power Action - Choose one: - Remove 3 Jedi support dice from your pool and spend 2 resources to flip this character. - Roll a Jedi die on one of your cards in play into your pool.

21045B.name: Rey
21045B.text: After you activate this character, roll a set-aside Luke Skywalker ([AW]35) die into your pool. If this character is elite, roll a set-aside Leia Organa ([RM]39) die into your pool. Power Action - Remove one of this character's character dice to heal damage from this character equal to the value showing on that die.
